text: Compliance and Clinical Quality, in one room, seeing the new access model on claims_detail_gold together for the first time.
Two real logins, live: a clinic analyst sees only Clinic 04 with identifiers redacted; a compliance officer sees all 15 clinics unmasked.
Then the honest part: a billed-amount rule ran at WARN severity for six weeks, letting 212 negative-amount rows through and understating one clinic's total by about $9,400.
WARN was a defensible call before the real pattern -- duplicate payer reversals -- was understood. Now it's DROP, backfilled, and every expectation is reviewed weekly, not just this one.
Both teams signed off in writing. Next: turning this into documents that outlive the meeting.
